limitations: This is a development diagnostic stress set, not a held-out benchmark and not production traffic.
The 86 cases are query variants for 39 diagnostic needs; they are not 86 independent failures.
Only eight need groups bind observed solver artifacts, drawn from five .dat files in evaluator runs; four groups share one probe run.
The other 31 need groups were derived from official documentation conditions and intentionally stress lexical diagnostic retrieval.
The observed artifacts contain no natural too-many-attempts, nonlinear nonconvergence, contact termination, Explicit termination, .msg, .sta, or launcher-stdout example.
Observed evaluator traces are not claimed to represent a production user distribution.
Gold pages and answer sections were reviewed directly against bound official HTML before retrieval rankings were run.
No page-family-disjoint or unseen-feature guarantee is claimed for this development set.
